subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this maintainer-labeled prompt-policy PR be rebased and consolidated into current sub-agent guidance, changed into a coherent no-nested-spawn policy, or manually closed as covered by current main?
rationale: The branch is small, but it changes model-facing delegation policy where current main already has overlapping guidance and explicitly supports configured nested spawning.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only the useful examples and merge them into existing availability-aware and depth-aware Tooling, Messaging, prefer-delegation, sub-agent prompt, or tool-description surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, docs, tests, and prompt surfaces together so the product contract is consistent.

options.title: Close As Covered
options.body: If current main guidance is sufficient, a maintainer can close this protected stale branch manually instead of carrying duplicate prompt text.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only the useful examples and merge them into existing availability-aware and depth-aware Tooling, Messaging, prefer-delegation, sub-agent prompt, or tool-description surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They proposed the current prompt-policy direction and already stated a product view on the related per-agent tool-policy proposal.
